missing_channel_strategy: Perrin spherical-spline interpolation from all measured source channels
data_layout: one NPZ per global subject under data/
split_protocol: LOSO for datasets <=10 subjects; subject-level 5-fold GroupKFold otherwise
standard_channel_set: predefined 32-electrode standard_1005 subset shared with PooledMI binary
channel_mask_semantics: True=model-valid channel; fixed True for sealed MI-32, never used as validity mask
measured_mask_semantics: True=original measured source channel; False=interpolated target channel
target_montage_provenance: channel list matched exactly to F:/pooled_mi_riemann_32interp/config.json; coordinates from MNE standard_1005
electrode_adjacency_method: RGNN inverse squared standard_1005 distance in centimetres
quality_flag_policy: 501 robust_extreme_review trials retained; exclusions require a predeclared train-independent sensitivity analysis
label_boundary_event_policy: hands/both_hands/both_hand events excluded upstream under the UEHF-MI v2.4 label ontology
